# VerusLink

> VerusLink builds Vero, an AI-native operating system for Australian small businesses. Vero replaces the admin overhead of running a business: receipts, invoicing, CRM, client follow-ups, scheduling, and financial reporting, delivered via Telegram. Designed for tradies, bookkeepers, recruiters, and NFPs who need a full back-office without hiring one.

VerusLink is founded by James Whitehill (Chief Connector) and operates as a one-person, multi-client AI infrastructure business. Vero is the product. The underlying platform is OpenClaw, self-hosted on a private VPS.

Vero is not a chatbot. It is a team of named AI agents, Finnegan (finance), Scout (research), Maven (marketing), Clio (CRM), and Orion (operations), that act on behalf of the business owner through a single Telegram interface.

Pricing is $499/month AUD with a one-time setup fee. One plan. All agents included.

Target customers: Australian SME owners who are time-poor, admin-heavy, and not technical. Best fit: tradies, bookkeepers, solo recruiters, NFP coordinators.

## Product

- [Home](https://veruslink.au): What Vero is and who it is for
- [Apply / Audit](https://audit.veruslink.au): Voice-based business audit to assess fit, free, 8 questions, generates a personalised proposal
- [Sign Up](https://signup.veruslink.au): Start a trial or purchase a plan
- [Client Portal](https://app.veruslink.au): Existing client login, dashboard, obligations, standing orders, support

## Agents

- **Finnegan**, Finance agent. Handles receipts, invoices, reimbursements, financial summaries, ATO mileage tracking, invoice chasing.
- **Scout**, Research agent. Delivers pre-meeting briefs, competitive intelligence, opportunity scanning, industry signals.
- **Maven**, Marketing agent. LinkedIn drafts, prospect scanning, cold outreach sequences, acquisition loop.
- **Clio**, CRM agent. Contact management, follow-up reminders, relationship tracking, deal radar.
- **Orion**, Operations agent. Scheduling, standing orders, obligation tracking, system health.

## Key Concepts

- Vero operates via Telegram, no app to install, no dashboard required for daily use
- All agents share a single business context per client (tenant memory)
- Shadow mode: all outbound emails are drafted for human approval before sending
- Tier gating: Command-tier clients get all 5 agents; lower tiers access Finnegan-first

## Verticals We Serve

- **Tradies**: quoting, receipt capture, subcontractor invoicing, job scheduling
- **Bookkeepers**: client receipt collection, BAS support, invoice chasing, client health summaries
- **Recruiters**: candidate pipeline, follow-up sequences, placement tracking
- **NFPs**: grant obligation tracking, donor follow-up, admin reporting
